newsitem.title: USA: Loehmann's sees lower Q1 shr.
newsitem.headline: Loehmann's sees lower Q1 shr.

text.p: Loehmann's Inc said on Thursday that it expects to report earnings per share of $0.14 to $0.20 for the first quarter ending May 3, 1997, compared with proforma earnings per share of $0.27 in last year's first quarter.
First quarter sales are expected to be in the range of $116 million-$118 million, Loehmann's said.
First Call's first quarter consensus of analysts' earnings estimates for Loehmann's was $0.32.

Loehmann's attributed the earnings decline to lower than anticipated sales in both its comparable store and new store base and higher than anticipated expenses from opening some stores earlier than planned.
Loehmann's said its same-store sales declined 2.8 percent for the fiscal year-to-date period and its sales volume at three locations was below its plan.
First quarter results will be reported on or about May 28, 1997.
